semanticConclusion: The municipality explicitly calls these 18 units city quarters; some are broad functional/statistical units and some garden-city or estate quarters. Planning/statistical purpose alone does not invalidate the source names. Their footprints must be checked separately; no group geometry is copied to individual contained quarters.
